slept_over_7_hrs: yes
wrote_gratitude_journal: yes
limited_screen_time_to_1_hr: yes

connected_with_friends: yes"""

    access_token=simple_note_access_token,
    title=new_title,
    content=new_content,
    tags=["habit-tracker"],

))
